title: drea-validate/1
description: Machine readable configuration check of a drea CLI app, as printed by --validate --json

valid.description: True exactly when findings is empty; the process exit code is 0 then

effective.description: The resolved configuration: one entry per option that ended up with a value (or was used); unset options are omitted

option.description: Option name, config file key or dotted command name the finding is about

source.description: Source that supplied the offending value; absent when no single source applies (e.g. missing_required)

code.description: Stable machine code; exit codes group them as 66 file_error, 78 unknown_key/missing_required/wrong_scope/unknown_option_ref/disabled_group, 65 the rest

message.description: Human readable message. Values of sensitive options are masked as [redacted]

value.description: Resolved values as an array, except for sensitive options where it is the string [redacted]

default.description: The declared default; present only when the option declares one (masked for sensitive options)

redundant.description: Present when a real source set the option to exactly its declared default
